items.call: POST one read-only Cypher statement to the in-VPC projection service on port 8181
items.fact: the row count of the Cypher answer to MATCH n RETURN count n
items.reason: The estate graph projection listens only inside the VPC on port 8181 and admits no client outside the gateway, so no second client can make this read.

items.call: GET /health on the in-VPC projection service on port 8181
items.fact: the served vintage of the estate graph projection
items.reason: The projection health read is reachable only inside the VPC on port 8181 and admits no client outside the gateway, so no second client can make this read.

items.call: one synchronous Lambda invoke of the published scoped API function with a GET payload for the section route
items.fact: the body of one security section from the published layer
items.reason: The only path the gateway shows is one synchronous Lambda invoke under the internal reader role grant, and no direct store read of the published layer appears in the gateway source.
